conversations_kind_owner.name: conversations_kind_owner
conversations_kind_owner.value:
("conversations"."kind" = 'group' AND "conversations"."owner_member_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'direct' AND "conversations"."owner_member_id" IS NOT NULL)

diary_entries_source_revision.name: diary_entries_source_revision
diary_entries_source_revision.value:
("diary_entries"."source_message_id" IS NULL AND "diary_entries"."source_revision" IS NULL)
    OR ("diary_entries"."source_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "diary_entries"."source_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "diary_entries"."source_revision" > 0)

inference_status.name: inference_status
inference_status.value:
("inference_candidates"."status" = 'pending' AND "inference_candidates"."retry_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inference_candidates"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("inference_candidates"."status" IN ('observed', 'dropped', 'published') AND "inference_candidates"."retry_at" IS NULL AND "inference_candidates"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

inference_delivery.name: inference_delivery
inference_delivery.value:
("inference_candidates"."status" = 'published' AND "inference_candidates"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inference_candidates"."message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inference_candidates"."letter_id" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("inference_candidates"."status" <> 'published' AND "inference_candidates"."ticket_id" IS NULL AND "inference_candidates"."message_id" IS NULL AND "inference_candidates"."letter_id" IS NULL)

publication_receipt_status.name: publication_receipt_status
publication_receipt_status.value:
("publication_receipts"."status" = 'pending' AND "publication_receipts"."retry_at" IS NOT NULL AND "publication_receipts"."resolved_at" IS NULL
      AND "publication_receipts"."message_id" IS NULL AND "publication_receipts"."letter_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("publication_receipts"."status" = 'dropped' AND "publication_receipts"."retry_at" IS NULL AND "publication_receipts"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "publication_receipts"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND "publication_receipts"."message_id" IS NULL AND "publication_receipts"."letter_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("publication_receipts"."status" = 'published' AND "publication_receipts"."retry_at" IS NULL AND "publication_receipts"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND ("publication_receipts"."message_id" IS NOT NULL OR "publication_receipts"."letter_id" IS NOT NULL))

ticket_inputs_source_proof.name: ticket_inputs_source_proof
ticket_inputs_source_proof.value:
("ticket_inputs"."source_message_id" IS NULL AND "ticket_inputs"."source_revision" IS NULL)
    OR ("ticket_inputs"."source_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_inputs"."source_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_inputs"."source_revision" > 0)

tickets_due_at.name: tickets_due_at
tickets_due_at.value:
("tickets"."kind" = 'followup' AND "tickets"."due_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("tickets"."kind" = 'errand' AND "tickets"."due_at" IS NULL)

tickets_status_stage.name: tickets_status_stage
tickets_status_stage.value:
("tickets"."status" = 'open'
    AND "tickets"."stage" IN ('scheduled', 'queued', 'thinking', 'waiting', 'quiet_waiting') AND "tickets"."ended_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("tickets"."status" = 'ended'
    AND "tickets"."stage" IN ('completed', 'failed', 'blocked', 'discarded', 'cancelled'))

triggers_source_proof.name: triggers_source_proof
triggers_source_proof.value:
("triggers"."source_message_id" IS NULL AND "triggers"."source_revision" IS NULL AND "triggers"."source" = 'app')
    OR ("triggers"."source_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "triggers"."source_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "triggers"."source_revision" > 0)

worker_reports_kind_run.name: worker_reports_kind_run
worker_reports_kind_run.value:
("worker_reports"."kind" = 'followup' AND "worker_reports"."run_id" IS NULL
    AND "worker_reports"."generation" IS NULL AND "worker_reports"."due_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("worker_reports"."kind" = 'errand' AND "worker_reports"."run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_reports"."generation" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_reports"."generation" >= 0 AND "worker_reports"."due_at" IS NULL)
